sourceRefs.locator: “Histoire du Cabinet”, “L’installation du cabinet au sein de la bibliothèque”: gallery above the rue Colbert open to visitors from 1741 and occupied until 1865.
Inv. 56.460, Description and Matières et techniques: inscription, costume, loss on 5 November 1831, wax impression in Ms. 609 fol. 63v, its rediscovery in 1857 and production of the gilt electrotype.

summary.de: Der Sammlungssaal lag bis 1865 über der Rue Colbert am Standort Richelieu.
summary.en: The collection occupied a gallery above the rue Colbert at the Richelieu site until 1865.
